short: Preparation of graphene oxide-based polyaniline composites w
title: Preparation of graphene oxide-based polyaniline composites with synergistic anticorrosion effect for waterborne polyurethane anticorrosive coatings

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: GO-filled coatings do not give long-term protection of steel. Pairing functionalised GO with phytic-acid-doped PANI in WPU should give synergistic long-term anticorrosion.
states.detail: Absorbed: h1 (HYP/need), h2 (HYP/hypothesis), d1 (DES/base_system), d2 (DES/modification), d3 (DES/variable_sweep), p1 (PRC/synthesis), p2 (PRC/synthesis), p3 (PRC/deposition), p4 (PRC/stimulus)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: PANI on FGO is in the phytic-acid-doped (protonated, phosphate-bearing) state. PANI_PA spheres lie scattered over the FGO sheets.
states.detail: Absorbed: s2 (STR/chemistry/bonding), s3 (STR/microstructure/distribution), s5a (STR/phase/identity), s5b (STR/phase/identity). Premises: IR band and XPS binding-energy assignments: sulfonate 1261/1095/799 cm-1; quinoid/benzenoid C-N; -NH+- ~399 eV; P-O/P=O; Reference diffraction lines of Fe, FeOOH, Fe2O3, Fe3O4 and [FenPA2]

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Dispersed graphene sheets lengthen the diffusion path of water, O2 and Cl- through the coating. PANI redox passivates steel, forming a dense Fe2O3/Fe3O4 oxide film.
states.detail: Absorbed: m1 (MEC/pathway), m2 (MEC/pathway), m3 (MEC/pathway), prp1 (PRP/value), prpr (PRP/value). Premises: PANI redox action forms a dense oxide layer on steel; Phytic acid complexes iron ions into insoluble substances on steel

states.title: Performance state
states.head: FGO/PANI_PA-2.5/WPU still protects steel after 60 d immersion in NaCl (|Z|0.01Hz ~1e8 Ohm cm2)

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Graphene barrier, PANI passivation and phytic-acid chelation act together to give FGO/PANI_PA/WPU efficient long-term anticorrosion

nodes.title: evidence, F2, F5
nodes.head: FGO spectrum gains weak bands near 1260, 1100 and 800 cm-1 absent in GO, assigned to sulfonate. FGO C 1s fit carries C-N (284.8 eV) and C-S components absent in GO
nodes.note: bands are weak; assignment is the paper's image labels C-S separately at 288.1 eV and C=O at 287.1 eV; text gives one C-N/C-S peak at 284.8 eV and C=O at 287.3 eV
nodes.detail: o1: FGO spectrum gains weak bands near 1260, 1100 and 800 cm-1 absent in GO, assigned to sulfonate; o2: FGO C 1s fit carries C-N (284.8 eV) and C-S components absent in GO
nodes.necessity_reason: s3 keeps shown support from o9 after removal.

nodes.title: evidence, F2, F5
nodes.head: FGO/PANI_PA spectrum shows PANI bands near 1568, 1483, 1300 and 1113 cm-1 and a band near 925 cm-1. FGO/PANI_PA N 1s resolves into -N= (397.1), -NH- (398.0) and -NH+- (399.0 eV).
nodes.solves: PANI on FGO is in the phytic-acid-doped (protonated, phosphate-bearing) state
nodes.detail: o4: FGO/PANI_PA spectrum shows PANI bands near 1568, 1483, 1300 and 1113 cm-1 and a band near 925 cm-1; o5: FGO/PANI_PA N 1s resolves into -N= (397.1), -NH- (398.0) and -NH+- (399.0 eV); o6: FGO/PANI_PA P 2p fits P=O (132.3), P-O (133.1) and POOH (131.4 eV)
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for s2 (o4, o5, o6).
